title: Pip and the Zebra Crossing Mix-Up
moral: When we listen carefully, we stay safe and happy together.
description: It's Market Day in Clover Wood! Pip can't wait to cross Clover Lane, but first Nana Hoot has a very important rule. Learn to stop, look left and right, and listen at the road with sock bunnies, a zooming snail and one very silly zebra hunt. A funny animated road safety story for kids aged 3 to 8.

narration.text: Hi friends! Guess what? Today is Market Day in Clover Wood! Hooray!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Pip, Tumble, let's go and buy strawberries! But first, listen. At the road, we STOP, LOOK and LISTEN.

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Yes, yes, Nana! Super-duper! Let's GO!
But Pip wasn't really listening. He zoomed off so fast... BOING! He got tangled in Nana's washing line! Now Pip had Nana's socks on his ears!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: HONK! Pip, you look like a sock bunny!
Soon they came to Clover Lane. Bicycles went zip, zip, ZOOM along the road!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Here we are, my dears. This is the zebra crossing. We cross the road right here.

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: A ZEBRA? Where? Is it hiding?
Tumble looked under a leaf. Pip looked behind a tree. No zebra anywhere! Tee-hee!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Hoo-hoo-HOO! A zebra crossing has black and white stripes, just like a zebra!

popups.sub: at the edge of the road

narration.text: Then Pip saw the strawberry stall across the road. Yummy! He got ready to run. One, two, three...

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: STOP, Pip!
Pip skidded back. Wheeeee... BONK! Right into Tumble's tummy! He tried again. Wheeeee... BONK! Tumble's tummy AGAIN!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Oopsie-trunk! My tummy is not a pillow, Pip!
Friends, what do we do first at the road? Do we run, or do we STOP?
STOP! Yes! You're so smart! And the third time, Pip stopped too.

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Next, we LOOK. Look left... and look right. Is anything coming?
Tumble looked left and right sooo fast. Left, right, left, right! Wibble-wobble! He got all dizzy!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Whoa! Now I can see TWO Nanas!
Ring, ring! A bunny zipped past on a red bicycle. Whoooosh! Good thing they looked and waited!

narration.speaker: hazel
narration.text: BOING! Tee-hee-hee! That bell made my prickles stand straight up!

narration.text: Then, we LISTEN with our ears. Shhh... Everyone listened.
ZOOM... ZOOOOM... Something was coming!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Is it a giant rocket? A flying banana-bus?
It was... a tiny snail on a tiny scooter! Zoom... zoom... sooooo slowly!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: HONK! Hello, Mister Snail! We will wait for you!
And they waited and waited, until he was all the way across. Good listening, everybody!
At last, they came to the big crossing by the market. It had a light that glows red or green!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Look! A traffic-lightning-thingy!
Tee-hee! It's called a TRAFFIC LIGHT, silly Pip! The light is RED. Should we stop, or go?
STOP! Red means stop. Hooray, you got it!
They waited so long, Nana Hoot fell asleep. Snore... Her glasses slipped down her beak. Then the light turned GREEN. HONK!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: I'm awake! I'm awake! Green means go, my dears. But look left and right again first!

At the road, what do we do with our eyes? Look up at the clouds? Or look left and right?
Left and right! Good looking, friends!
And what does a red light mean?
STOP! Red means stop! You remembered everything! Super-duper!

narration.text: Thank you, Nana! Next time, I will listen right away. Stop, look and listen!

narration.speaker: tumble

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Hoo-hoo-HOO! You all listened so well today. I'm proud of you, my dears.
